definition_of_physics_gated: Physics-Gated PRAJNA is a hybrid architecture: a learned deep neural network forecaster coupled with a deterministic First-Law thermodynamic validation rule filter (primary heat balance & kinematic projector).
honest_physics_discussion: Model B reduces dynamic energy violation by ~58% compared to unconstrained temporal networks. However, it retains a non-zero residual (~78 MWth, ~10% of 756 MWth) compared to clean ODE integration (0.011 MWth). This gap reflects finite neural surrogate capacity, multi-objective loss balancing, and discrete time-stepping.
